column1: This option enables the Service Level Agreement, which defines service quality by setting indicators on the maximum resolution time for a ticket, or the transition to a certain stage within a given time. If enabled, your teams will be alerted of the indicators to meet, and you will have access to detailed reports showing SLA performance and service level.
